objective: Acquire and authenticate the official open-source DINOv2 ViT-S/14 checkpoint on CPU, unblock R4 provenance, and stage R5 XY-beta against the already frozen supplier-agnostic per-class 44b6 separation gate without running features or opening outcomes.

human_authorization.scope: official open-source source and exact DINOv2 ViT-S/14 pretrained weight only

source_authentication_contract.revision: resolve an exact immutable official commit before use
source_authentication_contract.license: authenticate exact LICENSE bytes from that commit
source_authentication_contract.checkpoint: official dinov2_vits14_pretrain.pth URL as enumerated by the pinned source
source_authentication_contract.checkpoint_sha256: compute before any deserialization and require exact pin thereafter
source_authentication_contract.local_checkpoint_policy: immutable content-addressed external cache; do not commit the large checkpoint

safe_load_contract.precondition: checkpoint byte count and SHA-256 must equal the newly frozen manifest
safe_load_contract.state_dict: mapping of string keys to tensors only; reject nested executable objects and non-tensor leaves
safe_load_contract.model_construction: construct dinov2_vits14 from the pinned official source with pretrained=false and init_values=1.0
safe_load_contract.load_state_dict: strict=true; zero missing and zero unexpected keys
safe_load_contract.validation: keyset equality, tensor shape equality, finite floating tensors, exact state_dict numel and model parameter count

r4_decision_rule.pass: Exact official source revision, source license, checkpoint URL, checkpoint SHA-256/bytes, tensor-only CPU load, strict keyset/shape match, and expected parameter count all authenticate. Propose R4 dependency satisfied; no tier move is implied.
r4_decision_rule.fail: Any provenance, license, hash, safe-load, keyset, shape, or parameter-count mismatch leaves R4 PARK-B and forbids R5.

r5_staging_contract.representation: Frozen XY view only under the existing 13 um physical crop, 33^3 sampling, pseudo-RGB, 224x224 resize, ImageNet normalization, and 768-D CLS-plus-central-patch contract.
r5_staging_contract.population: exact frozen fit-only 44b6 delete and occupied_swap populations

arms.A1: incumbent plus true DINOv2 XY supplier descriptors
arms.A0: incumbent plus deterministic within-frame node-consistent permutation of DINOv2 XY features

r5_staging_contract.probe: class-balanced standardized ridge least-squares binary rank probe, lambda 0.01, deterministic float64
r5_staging_contract.pass_semantics: A future class-local PASS unlocks only a newly frozen 44b6 graph-gate preregistration for human review; no tier promotion or graph execution.
r5_staging_contract.fail_semantics: A future class-local FAIL parks only this DINOv2 supplier x action_class instantiation PARK-C; it does not kill DINOv2 or dense embeddings.

hard_stops: feature generation requiring GPU or forbidden compute
tier census, LIVE_STATE, LEDGER, or kaggle_budget write
barrier: RETURN R4 AUTHENTICATION AND R5 STAGING FRAGMENTS TO ROOT; ROOT ALONE MERGES SHARED STATE
